description: Defines the TranscodingSessionController class, which manages media transcoding sessions, including session submission, control, callbacks, and resource management within Android's media framework.

classes.name: TranscodingSessionController
classes.description: Manages media transcoding sessions, handles session lifecycle, callbacks, resource policies, and maintains session states.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a new transcoding session request.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific session.

methods.name: addClientUid
methods.description: Associates a client UID with a session.

methods.name: getClientUids
methods.description: Gets UIDs associated with a session.

methods.name: onPaused
methods.description: Callback when a session is paused.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Callback when an error occurs in a session.

methods.name: onUidGone
methods.description: Callback when a UID is gone.

methods.name: dumpAllSessions
methods.description: Outputs all session info to a file descriptor.
